title: Traveling the South East Asia Series
alt: Watch Traveling the South East Asia Series on YouTube
text: Since I was always into the video after I finished my semester abroad in South Korea, I have decided to travel and film everything I experience. It was kinda my experiment whether or not I would like to do vlogging on regular basis. I ended up uploading 19 videos on YouTube from my travels through Taiwan, Philippines, Singapore, and Malaysia.
